summary: Phase 5 Business Assistant personalization — backend + frontend integration tested. Backend: 15/15 pytest tests PASSED against the live preview URL covering preferences (quick/guided/power + invalid), saved-commands CRUD + record-run + empty-command rejection, routines CRUD + 1-8 validation + record-run, smart-defaults/last-order-customer, next-step-suggestions (create_order + dynamic order_id substitution + unknown action returns []), bulk/overdue-reminders preview and graceful send, and auth-required 401. Frontend: login OK, FloatingAssistant opens from /dashboard, all Phase 5 data-testids are present and wired — mode switcher with Quick/Guided/Power buttons (all clickable and trigger PUT /api/ai/assistant/preferences), empty state with smart-default chip ('Use Phase3 Lookup Co again?'), Routines button, Remind overdue chip, Saved/Pinned commands section, and Try examples. The 'Remind overdue' chip AND the typed command 'remind overdue' both trigger the AssistantBulkActionCard — in this tenant there are no overdue invoices, so the card renders its empty variant (assistant-bulk-empty) with message 'No overdue invoices — nothing to remind.' which is correct behavior. Pin buttons (assistant-pin-btn-<msgId>) appear next to user messages. Routines modal testids exist (assistant-open-routines, assistant-routines-modal, assistant-routine-new-name, assistant-routine-new-commands, assistant-routine-save, assistant-routine-delete-<id>).
action_items: Consider seeding at least one overdue invoice in the demo tenant so testers can exercise the non-empty AssistantBulkActionCard (Confirm/Cancel buttons) end-to-end. Current tenant has zero overdue → only the assistant-bulk-empty variant is exercised by humans.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/ai_assistant_prefs.py:70-86 — NEXT_STEP_SUGGESTIONS is a module-level dict shared across tenants/users. Fine for the current rule-based design, but if per-tenant customization is added later, ensure it's not mutated in place; treat as read-only constant.

routes/ai_assistant_prefs.py:420-431 — overdue-reminders/send has a hard cap of 100 via list slicing. For tenants with >100 overdue invoices the excess is silently skipped (`skipped` is reported). Consider returning a pagination/cursor instead of silently dropping.

routes/ai_assistant_prefs.py:449-453 — the invoices.update_many sets reminder_queued_at/by but there's no guard against re-queueing an already-queued invoice within a short window — a user double-clicking 'Confirm' will create duplicate audit entries. Add a cooldown check (e.g., skip if reminder_queued_at within last N hours) if dedupe matters.

routes/ai_assistant_prefs.py:219-221 — the 1–8 commands validation is good, but the error message 'A routine must contain 1–8 commands' uses an en-dash which is non-ASCII. Not a bug; just note for any strict JSON consumers.

routes/ai_assistant_prefs.py:115-123 — list_saved_commands sorts by 'pinned' then 'updated_at'. Consider a compound index on (tenant_id, user_id, pinned, updated_at) if the saved_commands collection grows — right now 100-doc limit makes it fine.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of exercised flows — all Phase 5 data-testids present and responsive

seed_data_creation: Backend tests created and cleaned up TEST_-prefixed saved commands and routines within each test. test_bulk_overdue_send_empty_is_graceful sent to a non-existent invoice_id so no real invoice data mutated. Frontend test did not create persistent data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file is /app/backend/tests/test_iteration118_phase5_assistant.py. Export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL before pytest. The OWNER tenant (d9c5507b-879c-4bec-9736-1dc841334719) has 9 pending invoices but ZERO overdue invoices — so the AssistantBulkActionCard always renders its empty variant (assistant-bulk-empty) on this tenant. To exercise the Confirm/Cancel happy path, seed an invoice with due_date in the past AND status != paid. Smart default chip shows 'Use Phase3 Lookup Co again?' — the last AI-created order customer. All Phase 5 data-testids verified present: floating-assistant-trigger, floating-assistant-panel, assistant-empty-state, assistant-mode-switcher, assistant-mode-{quick|guided|power}, assistant-open-routines, assistant-bulk-reminders-chip, assistant-saved-commands, assistant-smart-default, assistant-bulk-empty, assistant-pin-btn-<messageId>, assistant-routines-modal, assistant-routine-new-name, assistant-routine-new-commands, assistant-routine-save. Next-step suggestions logic for create_order correctly substitutes {order_id} into the 'View this order' route template.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Phase 5 backend + frontend both ship clean.
